blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adversarial robustness distillation typically treats a robust teacher as a fixed knowledge source and transfers robustness to a compact student in a one-way manner. This paradigm terminates teacher-student interaction once the student is distilled, thereby discarding potentially useful feedback from the distilled student. However, exploiting such feedback is nontrivial because indiscriminate weak-to-strong transfer may propagate student errors to the teacher. To address this issue, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that turns the distilled student into a feedback source for refining the robust teacher and subsequently transfers the teacher gains back to the same student. CARD first performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation and then uses reliability-enhanced student feedback to refine the robust teacher. The refinement combines inverse adversarial student feedback with teacher-student discrepancy maximization, after which the refined teacher is used to continue training the same student under the unchanged base distillation objective. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for reliable weak-to-strong feedback transfer and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher's risk. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base distillation methods show that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy. These results show that the distilled student can provide useful feedback to the teacher, enabling robustness transfer to proceed beyond the conventional one-way teacher-to-student paradigm.
blocks.zh: 逆向稳健性蒸馏一般将稳健的教师视为固定的知识来源,并以单向方式将稳健性转移给紧凑的学生. 这种范式在学生被蒸馏后终止了师生之间的相互作用,从而抛弃了蒸馏后学生潜在的有益反馈. 然而,利用这种反馈是非部落性的,因为不分青红皂白的弱到强的转移可能会向教师传播学生的错误。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出Cyclic Adversarial Raverstness Dispiration(CARD),这是一种封闭式框架,将蒸馏后的学生转化为完善强健的教师的反馈来源,随后将教师的收益转回给同一个学生. CARD首先进行强对弱对抗式蒸馏,然后利用可靠性增强的学生反馈来完善强师. 完善后结合了反向对抗的学生反馈和师生差异最大化,之后在不变的基础蒸馏目标下,利用完善后的教师继续培养同一个学生. 我们进一步为可靠的弱到强反馈传输建立一个样本级的充分条件,并从精细教师的风险上得出分布级的上限. 关于CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet-10的实验跨越了多个师生结构和基底蒸馏方法,表明CARD在大多数评价环境中提高了对抗力,同时总体上保持了干净的准确性。 这些结果显示,被蒸馏的学生可以向老师提供有益的反馈,使得强力转移能够超越传统的单向师生模式.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Lightweight neural networks are increasingly deployed on mobile, edge, and embedded devices because of their low computational and storage costs [ 41 ] .
However, their limited capacity makes it difficult to maintain both clean accuracy and adversarial robustness [ 7 , 8 , 37 ] .
Adversarial training improves robustness by optimizing models against adversarial perturbations [ 28 ] , but its effectiveness often relies on substantial model capacity and computational cost [ 42 , 21 ] .
Adversarial robustness distillation provides a practical alternative by transferring robust knowledge from a high-capacity robust teacher to a compact student [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
轻量级神经网络越来越多地被部署在移动,边缘和嵌入式设备上,因为它们的计算和存储成本都很低 [41].
然而,由于能力有限,难以保持干净的准确性和对抗力[7、8、37]。
逆向训练通过优化对抗性扰动模式[28]来提高稳健性,但其有效性往往依赖于大量的模型能力和计算成本[42,21].
横向强力分馏通过将强力知识从高能强力教师转移到紧凑的学生[13],提供了一个实用的替代.

blocks.en:
Existing adversarial-distillation methods mainly focus on improving the transfer of robust knowledge from teacher to student.
Representative approaches employ robust soft labels [ 43 ] , adaptive teacher guidance [ 16 ] , feature or gradient alignment [ 1 , 24 ] , and adversarial trajectory modeling [ 9 ] .
Despite these advances, most methods still follow a one-way teacher-to-student paradigm in which the teacher remains fixed throughout distillation.
Once distillation is completed, the student becomes the endpoint of the transfer process. This one-way formulation may leave potentially useful teacher-student interactions underexploited. Although the distilled student remains weaker than the robust teacher overall, its predictions can still provide complementary feedback, while teacher-student disagreement can reveal inputs on which their behaviors differ substantially. This observation motivates us to investigate whether feedback from the distilled student can be used to refine a stronger robust teacher. However, weak-to-strong feedback can be risky, as aligning a strong teacher with predictions from a weaker student may propagate student errors and degrade the teacher.
The central challenge is therefore to exploit student feedback while reducing the risk of erroneous knowledge transfer and focusing teacher refinement on informative regions of the input space.
blocks.zh:
现有的对抗-消化方法主要侧重于改善教师向学生传授强健知识。
代表性方法采用强软标签[43],适应性教师指导[16],特征或梯度调整[1,24],对抗性轨迹模型[9].
尽管取得了这些进步,但大多数方法仍然遵循教师对学生的单向模式,在这种模式中,教师在整个蒸馏过程中始终固定不变.
蒸馏完成后,学生会成为转移过程的终点. 这种单向表述可能使师生之间的有益互动得不到充分利用。 尽管被分解的学生仍然比强健的教师整体弱,但其预测仍能提供互补反馈,而师生分歧则能揭示出他们行为相去甚远的投入. 这一观察促使我们调查来自被蒸馏的学生的反馈是否可以用来完善更强壮的教师. 然而,弱到强的反馈可能具有风险,因为使强的教师与弱小学生的预测保持一致可能会传播学生的错误并贬低教师.
因此,中心挑战是利用学生的反馈,同时减少知识转移错误的风险,并把教师的完善重点放在投入空间的信息区上。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Distillation (CARD), a closed-loop framework that extends conventional one-way robustness transfer into a teacher-student feedback cycle.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , CARD consists of strong-to-weak adversarial distillation, weak-to-strong teacher refinement, and subsequent strong-to-weak gain transfer.
CARD first trains a compact student under the guidance of a pretrained robust teacher using an existing adversarial-distillation objective.
The distilled student is then frozen and used to refine the teacher through two complementary mechanisms.
For clean-input refinement, CARD constructs inverse adversarial examples that reduce the student’s classification loss and uses the resulting student predictions to supervise the teacher on the corresponding clean inputs.
For robust refinement, CARD identifies perturbed inputs by maximizing the discrepancy between the clean student prediction and the teacher prediction on the perturbed input, and then uses the clean student prediction to supervise the teacher on these inputs. After refinement, the teacher is frozen and used to continue training the same student from its previous checkpoint under the unchanged base distillation objective. In this way, CARD reorganizes the teacher-student training process into a closed feedback loop without requiring a redesign of the base distillation loss.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出Cyclic Adversarial Robustness Dispiration(CARD),这是一种将常规的单向强性转移延伸至师生反馈周期的闭路框架.
如图1所示,CARD包括强到弱的对抗分馏,弱到强的师资精炼,以及随后强到弱的增益转移.
CARD首先在经过预先培训的强健教师的指导下,利用现有的对抗-消化目标,培养出一名紧凑的学生.
后被分解出的学生被冷冻并用来通过两种互补机制来完善老师.
为了完善清洁投入,CARD构建了反向对抗性的例子,减少了学生的分类损失,并利用由此产生的学生预测来监督教师相应的清洁投入.
为了进行有力的改进,CARD通过将清洁学生预测与教师预测在扰动输入上的差距最大化来识别扰动输入,再用清洁学生预测来监督老师对这些输入. 经完善后,该教师被冷冻并用于在未改变的基底蒸馏目标下,继续从原来的检查站训练同一名学生. 这样,CARD将师生培训流程重组为封闭回馈回回路而无需重新设计基础分馏损失.

blocks.en: A key question is whether feedback from a weaker student can be used to refine a stronger teacher without compromising correct predictions. We therefore provide theoretical analysis of the weak-to-strong refinement process. At the sample level, we establish a sufficient condition under which aligning the teacher with student feedback preserves the correct prediction. At the distribution level, we further derive an upper bound on the refined teacher’s classification risk. These results characterize when weak-to-strong feedback can be transferred reliably and provide theoretical support for the proposed closed-loop formulation.
blocks.zh: 一个关键问题是,弱小学生的反馈是否可以用来完善更强的教师而不损害正确的预测. 因此,我们对弱到强的完善进程进行了理论分析。 在抽样方面,我们建立了充分的条件,使教师与学生反馈保持一致,从而保持正确的预测。 在分配层面,我们进一步从教师的分类风险中得出一个上限。 这些结果的特点是,弱到强的反馈能够可靠地转移,并为拟议的闭路制剂提供理论支持。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We introduce CARD, a closed-loop adversarial robustness distillation framework in which a distilled student is used to refine the robust teacher, and the refined teacher then guides further training of the same student. CARD retains the original adversarial-distillation objective for student training, allowing it to augment existing methods without redesigning their base losses. • We develop a student-feedback-based teacher-refinement mechanism that improves feedback quality and focuses refinement on regions of teacher-student disagreement. Inverse adversarial examples provide lower-loss student feedback for clean-input refinement, and discrepancy maximization identifies adversarial inputs for robust refinement. We further establish a sample-level sufficient condition for preserving correct predictions under weak-to-strong feedback and derive a distribution-level upper bound on the refined teacher’s classification risk. • We conduct extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet-10 across multiple teacher-student architectures and base adversarial-distillation methods. CARD improves adversarial robustness over the corresponding base methods in most evaluated settings while generally preserving clean accuracy, and ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of the proposed teacher-refinement and closed-loop mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入了CARD,一个闭锁的对抗强力分馏框架,在这个框架中,一个被分馏的学生用来精炼强力教师,精炼的教师然后指导对同一名学生的进一步培训. • CARD保留了学生培训的最初对抗-消化目标,使其得以在不重新设计其基本损失的情况下,扩大现有方法。 我们建立以学生为本的师资补习机制,提高反馈质量,重点完善师生分歧地区. 反相对抗的例子为清洁投入的完善提供了较低损失的学生反馈,而差异的最大化则确定了强劲完善的对抗性投入. 我们进一步建立一个样本级的充分条件,在弱到强的反馈下保持正确的预测,并得出经精炼的教师分类风险的分布级上限。 我们对CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet-10进行了广泛的实验,涉及多个师生建筑和基础对抗-平分方法。 CARD改进了大多数评价环境中对应基方法的对抗力强性,同时总体上保持了干净的准确性,而校外研究则进一步验证了拟议的教师精炼和闭合机制的有效性.

Snowflake and flame symbols denote frozen and trainable networks, respectively.

Figure 2: Overview of CARD.
Stage 1 performs strong-to-weak adversarial distillation from a pretrained robust teacher to a compact student.
Stage 2 freezes the first-round student and uses inverse adversarial examples and teacher adversarial examples to refine the pretrained teacher.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, we review the three lines of research most closely related to CARD, including adversarial training, adversarial robustness distillation, and teacher adaptation with weak-to-strong feedback.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们回顾与CARD最密切相关的三行研究,包括对抗性培训、对抗性强分馏和教师适应性强弱的反馈。

blocks.en: 2.1 Adversarial Training
blocks.zh: 2.1 横向培训

blocks.en:
Adversarial training improves model robustness by training against adversarial examples generated within a prescribed perturbation set.
PGD-AT [ 28 ] formulated adversarial training as a min–max optimization problem and has become a widely adopted baseline for adversarial robustness.
Subsequent studies have improved adversarial training from different perspectives, including adapting attack difficulty during training [ 3 , 40 , 35 , 18 ] , mitigating the trade-off between clean accuracy and adversarial robustness [ 39 , 34 , 36 ] , and redesigning the training objective [ 29 , 6 ] .
Other approaches further enhance robust learning by exploiting informative training samples and local neighborhood structures [ 26 , 25 , 10 , 30 , 12 ] .
Despite this progress, achieving strong adversarial robustness remains difficult for compact networks with limited representational capacity.
This limitation motivates adversarial robustness distillation, which transfers robust knowledge from a high-capacity teacher to a lightweight student.
blocks.zh:
横向培训通过针对在规定的扰动套内产生的对抗性实例进行培训,提高了模式的稳健性。
PGD-AT [28] 将对抗性训练作为分钟-最大优化问题,并已成为广泛采用的对抗性强性基准。
随后的研究从不同角度改进了对抗性训练,包括在训练过程中调整攻击难度[3,40,35,18],减轻了清洁准确性和对抗性强性之间的取舍[39,34,36],并重新设计了训练目标[29,6].
其他方法通过利用信息化培训样本和地方邻里结构来进一步加强强有力的学习[26、25、10、30、12]。
尽管取得了这些进展,但对于代表性能力有限的紧凑网络来说,仍然难以实现强烈的对抗力。
这一限制刺激了对抗力强力分馏,将强力知识从高能力教师转移到轻量级学生身上.

blocks.en: 2.2 Adversarial Robustness Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 异常强壮的蒸发

blocks.en:
Adversarial robustness distillation transfers robust knowledge from a pretrained teacher to a compact student, aiming to improve student robustness without increasing its model capacity.
ARD [ 13 ] incorporates robust teacher supervision into the adversarial training of the student.
Subsequent methods improve teacher supervision through robust soft labels or adaptive guidance [ 43 , 42 ] , and enrich knowledge transfer through feature, gradient, or adversarial-trajectory alignment [ 1 , 24 , 9 ] .
Other approaches further adapt the distillation process to the current student.
PeerAiD [ 19 ] jointly trains an online peer tutor with the student, and AdaAD [ 16 ] exploits teacher-student discrepancy to generate adaptive adversarial examples for student training.
blocks.zh:
逆向稳健分解将强健的知识从受过预训的教师转移到紧凑的学生身上,目的是提高学生稳健性而不会提高其模式能力.
ARD[13]将有力的教师监督纳入学生的对抗性训练中.
随后的方法通过强软标签或适应性指导[43、42]改进了教师监督,并通过特征、梯度或对抗-导线对接[1、24、9]来丰富知识转让。
其他方法进一步使蒸馏过程适应现在的学生.
PeerAiD [19] 与学生联合培养在线同龄导师,而AdaAD [16] 利用师生差异为学生培训提供适应性对抗性实例.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, existing methods primarily focus on improving knowledge transfer from the teacher to the student.
The distilled student is generally treated as the recipient of robust knowledge rather than as a source of feedback for refining the teacher after distillation.
Although both AdaAD and CARD exploit teacher-student discrepancy, the discrepancy serves different roles in the two frameworks.
AdaAD uses it to generate adaptive adversarial examples for student training, whereas CARD employs discrepancy maximization in a separate weak-to-strong stage to identify perturbed inputs where the frozen student’s predictions are used to refine the robust teacher.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进步,但现有方法主要侧重于改善教师向学生的知识转让。
被蒸馏的学生一般被视为强健知识的接受者,而不是被蒸馏后对教师进行精炼的反馈来源.
虽然AdaAD和CARD都利用师生差异,但差异在两个框架中起到不同的作用。
AdaAD用它来为学生培训提供适应性对抗性的例子,而CARD则在单独的弱到强阶段使用差异最大化来识别扰动的投入,其中被冻结的学生的预测被用来完善强健的教师.

blocks.en: 2.3 Teacher Adaptation and Weak-to-Strong Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 教师适应和薄弱学习

blocks.en:
Several recent adversarial-distillation methods move beyond a strictly fixed supervisory model.
PeerAiD [ 19 ] jointly trains an online peer tutor with the student, and CIARD [ 27 ] adopts a multi-teacher cyclic framework with clean and robust teachers and iteratively updates the robust teacher during student training.
These methods adapt the supervisory model concurrently with student learning.
CARD considers a different setting in which teacher refinement is performed after the student has completed an initial adversarial-distillation stage.
Freezing the distilled student provides a stable feedback source and decouples weak-to-strong refinement from the evolving student-training dynamics, allowing post-distillation student feedback and teacher-student discrepancies to be explicitly utilized for teacher refinement.
The resulting teacher is then used to provide updated robustness supervision to the same student, so that teacher refinement ultimately serves the further improvement of the compact student.
blocks.zh:
最近的几种对抗-消化方法超越了严格固定的监督模式。
PeerAiD [19] 与学生共同培训在线同龄导师,CIARD [27] 采用了由干净而强健的教师组成的多教师循环框架,并在学生培训期间反复更新强健的教师.
这些方法与学生学习同时调整监督模式.
CARD认为,在学生完成最初的对抗-消化阶段之后,教师的修炼是一种不同的环境。
冻结被分解的学生提供了一个稳定的反馈源,并脱离了不断演变的学生-培训动态的弱到强的完善,使分解后的学生反馈和师生差异被明确用于教师的完善.
由此产生的教师随后被用来为同一名学生提供更新的强健性监督,从而使教师的完善最终为紧凑学生的进一步改善服务.

blocks.en:
A related line of work, weak-to-strong learning, investigates whether supervision from a weaker model can improve a stronger model [ 2 , 22 , 11 ] .
Although this direction is closely related to the teacher-refinement stage of CARD, existing weak-to-strong studies typically focus on improving the stronger model itself.
CARD instead incorporates weak-to-strong feedback into adversarial robustness distillation, where improving the teacher is not the final objective but an intermediate step toward further enhancing the compact student’s robustness.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
CARD extends conventional one-way adversarial robustness distillation into a closed teacher-student feedback loop.
Given a training set 𝒟 = { ( x i , y i ) } i = 1 N \mathcal{D}=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N} , a pretrained robust teacher T ( 0 ) T^{(0)} , and an initialized compact student S ( 0 ) S^{(0)} , CARD proceeds through three sequential stages.
The first strong-to-weak stage distills robust knowledge from T ( 0 ) T^{(0)} to obtain a first-round student S ( 1 ) S^{(1)} .
The student is then frozen and used as a stable feedback source to refine the original teacher, producing T ( 1 ) T^{(1)} .
Finally, the refined teacher provides updated robustness supervision to the same student, yielding the final student S ( 2 ) S^{(2)} . Figure 2 shows the complete workflow.

blocks.en:
Weak-to-strong refinement must address two related issues.
First, directly transferring arbitrary student predictions may propagate student errors to the teacher.
Second, teacher refinement should focus on inputs where student feedback is more informative.
CARD addresses these issues through inverse adversarial student feedback and teacher-student discrepancy maximization, respectively.

其次,教师的完善应侧重于学生反馈信息更丰富的投入。
CARD分别通过学生反向反馈和师生差异最大化来解决这些问题.

The bound shows that the teacher risk is controlled by two factors: errors already present in the student feedback and teacher-student misalignment relative to the feedback margin.
For correctly classified student feedback, a larger positive margin or a smaller KL divergence reduces the margin-normalized misalignment term in the bound.
blocks.zh:
约束表明教师风险由两个因素所控制:学生反馈中已经存在的错误和师生相对于反馈比值的错位.
对于正确分类的学生反馈,较大的正差或较小的KL相差会减少约束中的比值-正差错位词.

blocks.en:
Theorem 2 does not, by itself, guarantee that teacher refinement always reduces classification risk.
Rather, the bound certifies a strict improvement over the pre-refinement teacher whenever the resulting upper bound is lower than the pre-refinement teacher risk evaluated on the same input distribution.
The analysis is therefore distribution-specific.
For the robust branch, it characterizes the discrepancy-selected perturbed inputs considered during refinement, rather than worst-case robustness over the entire perturbation set.
blocks.zh:

因此,分析是针对分配的。
对于稳健的分支而言,其特点是在改进过程中考虑的有差异的、选定的干扰性投入,而不是整个扰动组的最坏情况稳健性。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate CARD through white-box and transfer-based black-box robustness experiments, followed by ablation studies, hyperparameter analysis, and qualitative visualization.
The experiments are designed to examine the effectiveness and generalizability of CARD across different datasets, student architectures, and base adversarial-distillation methods.
blocks.zh:
我们通过白箱和转移式黑箱坚固性实验来评价CARD, 之后是消化学研究,超参数分析,以及定性可视化.
这些实验旨在审查CARD在不同数据集、学生结构以及基准对抗-平稳方法方面的有效性和可推广性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
This subsection describes the datasets, network architectures, compared methods, training configurations, and evaluation protocols used throughout the experiments.
Unless otherwise stated, a baseline method and its corresponding CARD variant use the same dataset split, model architecture, and base adversarial-distillation configuration.
blocks.zh:
本分节介绍整个实验中使用的数据集,网络架构,比较方法,培训配置,以及评价协议.
除非另有说明,基准方法及其相应的CARD变体使用相同的数据集分解,模型架构,以及基础对抗-分解配置.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Datasets and preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 数据集和预处理。

blocks.en:
We evaluate CARD on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 [ 20 ] , and a fixed ten-class subset of TinyImageNet [ 23 ] , denoted as TinyImageNet-10.
CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 each contain 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images at a spatial resolution of 32 × 32 32\times 32 pixels, with 10 and 100 classes, respectively.
We use the original training and test partitions without introducing additional training data.
blocks.zh:
我们用CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100 [20],以及TinyImageNet[23]的固定十等子集来评价CARD,表示为TinyImageNet-10.
CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100各包含5万个训练图像和10000个测试图像,空间分辨率分别为32×3232\times 32像素,分别设有10个和100个班.
我们使用最初的训练和测试分区,而不引入额外的训练数据.

blocks.en:
TinyImageNet-10 consists of ten fixed classes selected from TinyImageNet.
For each class, all 500 training images and 50 validation images are retained, resulting in 5,000 training images and 500 evaluation images at a spatial resolution of 64 × 64 64\times 64 pixels.
The original TinyImageNet training and validation splits are used for training and evaluation, respectively.
The selected classes are Goldfish, King penguin, American alligator, Bullet train, School bus, Broom, Bucket, Hourglass, Snorkel, and Espresso.
The same TinyImageNet-10 subset is used in all experiments.
blocks.zh:
TinyImageNet-10由从TinyImageNet中选取的十个固定类组成.
每个班级保留了全部500个训练影像和50个验证影像,以64×64\times64像素的空间分辨率产生了5000个训练影像和500个评价影像.
最初的"TinyImageNet"培训和验证分拆分别用于培训和评价.
选定的班级有:金鱼、王企鹅、美国鳄鱼、子弹列车、校车、Broom、Bucket、Hourglass、Snorkel和Espresso。
在所有实验中都使用同样的TinyImageNet-10子集.

blocks.en:
For training, we apply random cropping with a padding of four pixels and random horizontal flipping, following commonly adopted preprocessing protocols in adversarial training [ 26 ] and adversarial distillation [ 24 , 16 ] .
No data augmentation is applied during evaluation.
blocks.zh:
在训练方面,我们采用由四个像素和随机水平翻转组成的随机裁剪,遵循对抗训练中通常采用的预处理规程[26]和对抗分馏[24,16]。
在评价过程中没有应用数据扩充。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Architectures and baselines.
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 结构和基线。

blocks.en:
We use WideResNet-28-10 (WRN-28-10) and WideResNet-34-10 (WRN-34-10) [ 38 ] as pretrained robust teachers.
ResNet-18 [ 15 ] and MobileNet-V2 [ 31 ] are used as student architectures.

The teacher is optimized using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a momentum of 0.9 0.9 , a weight decay of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , and a batch size of 128.
Teacher refinement is performed for 20 epochs.
The learning rate is initialized to 0.02 0.02 , reduced to 0.01 0.01 after the 10th epoch, and further reduced to 0.001 0.001 after the 18th epoch.
The temperature used in the KL-divergence terms is fixed to τ = 1.0 \tau=1.0 .
The selection of λ \lambda is further analyzed in Section 4.5 .

For both inverse adversarial feedback and teacher–student discrepancy maximization, perturbations are constrained within an ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} ball with radius ϵ = 8 / 255 \epsilon=8/255 .
Each inner optimization is performed for 10 steps with a step size of 2 / 255 2/255 .
After each step, the perturbed input is projected back onto the corresponding ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} ball centered at the clean input and clipped to the valid input range.

The student-distillation objective and adversarial-example generation procedure follow those of the corresponding base adversarial-distillation method, with method-specific hyperparameters retained unless otherwise stated.

学生消沉客观和对抗-模拟生成程序遵循相应的基础消沉方法,除非另有说明,特定方法的超参数保留.

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 评价协议。

blocks.en:
For white-box evaluation, we consider FGSM [ 14 ] ,
PGD-20 [ 28 ] ,
a 20-step attack based on the CW margin loss [ 4 ] ,
and AutoAttack [ 5 ] .
All attacks are constrained by an ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} perturbation budget of ϵ = 8 / 255 \epsilon=8/255 .
For PGD-20 and the CW-20 attack, the step size is 2 / 255 2/255 .
Each white-box attack is generated directly against the evaluated target model, and the same attack configuration is used for a baseline and its corresponding CARD variant.
AutoAttack is evaluated in its standard configuration, comprising APGD-CE, APGD-DLR, FAB, and Square Attack, under the same ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} perturbation budget.
blocks.zh:
对于白盒评价,我们认为密克罗尼西亚[14],
PGD-20 [28],
a 基于CW比值损失的20分步攻击[4],
和自动攻击 [5] 。
所有攻击都受到一个l\\ \ ell\\infty}干扰预算 = 8/ 255\ epsilon=8/255。

For transfer-based black-box evaluation, adversarial examples are first generated against independently trained surrogate models and then transferred directly to the target student without access to the target model parameters or gradients during attack generation.
We consider PGD-100 and CW-100, both with ϵ = 8 / 255 \epsilon=8/255 and a step size of 2 / 255 2/255 .

对于基于转移的黑盒评价,对抗性的例子首先针对独立训练的代孕模型生成,然后直接被转移给目标学生,在攻击生成过程中没有访问目标模型参数或梯度.

blocks.en:
The robust surrogate models include ResNet-18, VGG-19 [ 33 ] , and MobileNet-V2, whereas the naturally trained surrogate models include ResNet-18, MobileNet-V2, VGG-19, ResNet-50, DenseNet-169 [ 17 ] , and WRN-34-10.
For each surrogate model and attack configuration, the same transferred adversarial examples are used to evaluate all target methods, ensuring that the baseline methods and their corresponding CARD variants are compared under identical transfer attacks.
blocks.zh:
强力代用模型包括ResNet-18,VGG-19 [33],和MobileNet-V2,而自然训练的代用模型包括ResNet-18,MobileNet-V2,VGG-19,ResNet-50,DenseNet-169 [17],和WRN-34-10.
对于每个代位模型和攻击配置,都使用相同的被转移对抗实例来评价所有的目标方法,确保基线方法及其相应的CARD变体在相同的转移攻击下进行比较.

blocks.en: 4.2 White-Box Robustness
blocks.zh: 4.2 白牛强壮

blocks.en: We first evaluate CARD under white-box attacks across different datasets, teacher architectures, student architectures, and base adversarial-distillation objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在白盒攻击下评估CARD, 跨越不同的数据集, 教师建筑,学生建筑, 以及基本对抗式的消化目标。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Results on CIFAR-10.
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 关于CIFAR-10的结果。

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the CIFAR-10 results with WRN-28-10 as the teacher.
For ResNet-18, applying CARD once to AdaAD+IGDM improves clean, FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy over the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline by 0.11 0.11 , 0.91 0.91 , 0.02 0.02 , 0.54 0.54 , and 0.17 0.17 percentage points, respectively.
Similarly, applying CARD once to AdaAD improves all five metrics over the original AdaAD baseline.
A second CARD cycle further increases clean, FGSM, and CW-20 accuracy relative to the one-cycle AdaAD-based variant, while slightly reducing PGD-20 and AA accuracy.
blocks.zh:
表1报告CIFAR-10结果,WRN-28-10为教师.
对于ResNet-18,将CARD一次应用到AdaAD+IGDM中,FGM,PGD-20,CW-20,AA的精度分别比原AdaAD+IGDM基准提高0.11.0.11分,0.91.0.91分,0.02.02分,0.54.0.54分,0.17.0.17分.
同样,对AdaAD适用CARD一次,比原先的AdaAD基线改进了所有五个度量.
第二个CARD周期比基于AdaAD的一周期变体进一步提高了清洁,FGSM和CW-20的精度,同时略微降低了PGD-20和AA的精度.

blocks.en:
For MobileNet-V2, the effect of CARD is more mixed.
Compared with the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline, applying CARD once increases FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.05 0.05 , 0.10 0.10 , 0.55 0.55 , and 0.49 0.49 percentage points, respectively, while reducing clean accuracy by 1.68 1.68 percentage points.
Compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD once increases clean, FGSM, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.03 0.03 , 0.38 0.38 , 0.89 0.89 , and 0.79 0.79 percentage points, respectively, whereas PGD-20 accuracy decreases by 0.14 0.14 percentage points.
These results indicate that the effect of CARD on CIFAR-10 varies with both the student architecture and the base adversarial-distillation objective.
blocks.zh:
对于MobileNet-V2,CARD的效果比较好有好有坏.
与原AdaAD+IGDM基准相比,CARD一度将FGSM,PGD-20,CW-20和AA的精度分别提高0.05 0.05分,0.10 0.10分,0.55 0.55分和0.49 0.49分,同时将纯度降低1.68 1.68分.
与原样相比 AdaAD基线,采用CARD后,将纯度、密克罗尼西亚、CW-20和AA的精度分别提高0.03 0.03分、0.38 0.38分、0.89 0.89分和0.79 0.79分,而PGD-20的精度则下降0.14 0.14分。
这些结果表明,CARD对CIFAR-10的影响因学生建筑和基本对抗-平分目标而异.

blocks.en:
Table 2 further reports the CIFAR-10 results with WRN-34-10 as the teacher.
For ResNet-18, compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD once increases clean, FGSM, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.17 0.17 , 0.10 0.10 , 0.27 0.27 , and 0.20 0.20 percentage points, respectively, while PGD-20 accuracy decreases by 0.49 0.49 percentage points.
Applying a second CARD cycle further changes the results relative to the one-cycle variant, increasing clean, FGSM, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.04 0.04 , 0.42 0.42 , 0.32 0.32 , and 0.12 0.12 percentage points, respectively, while PGD-20 accuracy decreases by an additional 0.29 0.29 percentage points.
Compared with the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline, applying CARD once improves clean, FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.28 0.28 , 0.35 0.35 , 0.09 0.09 , 0.41 0.41 , and 0.45 0.45 percentage points, respectively.
This AdaAD+IGDM-based CARD variant achieves the highest FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy among the evaluated ResNet-18 student methods.
blocks.zh:
表2还报告了CIFAR-10的结果,其中WRN-34-10为教师。
关于ResNet-18, 与原作比较 AdaAD基线,采用CARD,曾经提高干净,FGM,CW-20,AA的精度分别提高0.17.0.17分,0.10.0.10分,0.27.0.27分和0.20分,而PGD-20的精度则下降0.49.0.49分.
应用第二个CARD周期将结果与一周期变体相比进一步改变,将纯度、密克罗尼西亚、CW-20和AA的精度分别提高0.040.04分、0.420.42分、0.320.32分和0.12分,而PGD-20的精度又降低了0.29分。
与最初的AdaAD+IGDM基线相比,采用CARD一度提高了清洁度,FGM,PGD-20,CW-20,AA的精度分别为0.28 0.28分,0.35 0.35分,0.09分,0.41分0.41分,0.45分0.45分.
这个基于AdaAD+IGDM的CARDM变体在被评价的ResNet-18学生方法中实现了最高的FGSM,PGD-20,CW-20和AA的准确性.

blocks.en:
For MobileNet-V2, the effect of CARD is again metric dependent.
Compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD once increases clean, FGSM, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.04 0.04 , 0.23 0.23 , 0.16 0.16 , and 0.07 0.07 percentage points, respectively, while PGD-20 accuracy decreases by 0.35 0.35 percentage points.
Compared with the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline, applying CARD once increases clean, FGSM, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.25 0.25 , 0.75 0.75 , 0.32 0.32 , and 0.03 0.03 percentage points, respectively, while PGD-20 accuracy decreases by 0.18 0.18 percentage points.
Among the evaluated MobileNet-V2 student methods, the AdaAD+IGDM-based CARD variant achieves the highest CW-20 and AA accuracy.
blocks.zh:
对于MobileNet-V2,CARD的效果再次依赖于度量.
与原样相比 AdaAD基线,采用CARD一次提高干净,FGSM,CW-20,AA精度分别提高0.040.04分,0.230.23分,0.160.16分和0.07分,而PGD-20精度则下降0.350.35分.
与最初的AdaAD+IGDM基线相比,采用CARD一度会提高纯度,FGSM,CW-20,AA的精度分别为0.250.25分,0.750.75分,0.320.32分和0.03分;而PGD-20的精度则会降低0.180.18分.
在被评价的MobileNet-V2学生方法中,基于AdaAD+IGDM的CARDM变体实现了最高的CW-20和AA精度.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Results on CIFAR-100.
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 关于CIFAR-100的结果。

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports the results on CIFAR-100 with WRN-34-10 as the teacher.
For ResNet-18, compared with the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline, applying CARD once improves clean, FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.13 0.13 , 0.70 0.70 , 0.49 0.49 , 0.67 0.67 , and 0.83 0.83 percentage points, respectively.
For MobileNet-V2, compared with the corresponding AdaAD+IGDM baseline, the improvements are 0.02 0.02 , 0.48 0.48 , 0.26 0.26 , 0.41 0.41 , and 0.30 0.30 percentage points, respectively.
CARD also consistently improves AdaAD after one cycle for both student architectures.
For ResNet-18, compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD once increases clean, FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.75 0.75 , 0.76 0.76 , 0.46 0.46 , 0.75 0.75 , and 0.39 0.39 percentage points, respectively.
For MobileNet-V2, the corresponding improvements over the original AdaAD baseline are 0.29 0.29 , 0.57 0.57 , 0.38 0.38 , 1.11 1.11 , and 0.85 0.85 percentage points.
These results show that one CARD cycle consistently improves both clean and robust accuracy over the corresponding AdaAD and AdaAD+IGDM baselines across the two evaluated student architectures.
blocks.zh:
表3以WRN-34-10为教师报告了CIFAR-100的结果。
对ResNet-18而言,与最初的AdaAD+IGDM基线相比,采用CARD一旦提高了清洁度,FGSM,PGD-20,CW-20和AA的精度分别提高了0.13.0.13分,0.70.0.70分,0.49.0.49分,0.67.0.67分和0.83.0.83分.
就MobileNet-V2而言,与相应的AdaAD+IGDM基线相比,改进率分别为0.02 0.02分、0.48 0.48分、0.26 0.26分、0.41 0.41分和0.30分。
CARD在两个学生建筑一个周期后也不断改进AdaAD.
对ResNet-18来说,与最初的AdaAD基线相比,采用CARD一次提高干净度,FGM,PGD-20,CW-20,AA的精度分别提高0.75.0.75分,0.76.0.76分,0.75.0.75分和0.39.0.39分.
就MobileNet-V2而言,与原先的AdaAD基线相比,相应的改进为:0.290.29;0.570.57;0.380.38;1.11.11;0.850.85个百分点。
这些结果显示,一个CARD周期在两个受评价的学生建筑中,对相应的AdaAD和AdaAD+IGDM基线不断提高清洁性和强性。

blocks.en:
For ResNet-18 with AdaAD, applying a second CARD cycle yields only marginal changes relative to the one-cycle variant.
Specifically, clean and FGSM accuracy increase by 0.02 0.02 percentage points each, PGD-20 and CW-20 accuracy decrease by 0.08 0.08 and 0.13 0.13 percentage points, respectively, and AA accuracy remains unchanged.
This result indicates that additional refinement-transfer cycles do not necessarily provide uniform improvements across all evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh:
对于配有AdaAD的ResNet-18,采用第二个CARD周期,相对于一个周期的变体,只能产生边际变化.
具体来说,清洁和FGSM精度分别提高0.02分0.02分,PGD-20和CW-20精度分别降低0.08分0.08分和0.13分0.13分,AA精度保持不变.
这一结果表明,额外的完善-转让周期不一定能对所有评价指标作出统一改进。

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Results on TinyImageNet-10.
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 小图像网-10的结果。

blocks.en:
Table 4 reports the results on TinyImageNet-10 with WRN-34-10 as the teacher and ResNet-18 as the student.
Compared with the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline, applying CARD once improves clean, FGSM, PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 1.40 1.40 , 1.00 1.00 , 0.40 0.40 , 0.80 0.80 , and 1.00 1.00 percentage points, respectively.
The resulting AdaAD+IGDM-based CARD variant achieves the highest robust accuracy under all four attacks among the evaluated student methods, while also improving clean accuracy over its corresponding baseline.
blocks.zh:
表4在TinyImageNet-10上报告了结果,WRN-34-10为老师,ResNet-18为学生.
与最初的AdaAD+IGDM基线相比,采用CARD一度提高了清洁度,FGM,PGD-20,CW-20,AA的精度分别提高了1.40 1.40分,1.00 1.00分,0.40 0.40分,0.80 0.80分和1.00 1.00分.
由此产生的AdaAD+IGDM基于CARDM的变体在被评价学生方法中的所有四种攻击中都实现了最强的精度,同时也比相应的基线提高了纯度.

blocks.en:
The effects of CARD are less uniform when combined with the other distillation objectives.
Compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD once increases clean and CW-20 accuracy by 0.80 0.80 and 0.40 0.40 percentage points, respectively, and leaves AA accuracy unchanged, while FGSM and PGD-20 accuracy decrease by 1.20 1.20 and 1.40 1.40 percentage points.
Compared with the original ARD baseline, applying CARD once increases clean and FGSM accuracy by 3.20 3.20 and 0.40 0.40 percentage points, respectively, leaves CW-20 accuracy unchanged, and decreases PGD-20 and AA accuracy by 1.00 1.00 percentage point each.
The ARD-based CARD variant achieves the highest clean accuracy among the evaluated student methods.
blocks.zh:
当与其他分馏目标结合时,CARD的效果不太统一.
与原样相比 AdaAD基线,采用CARD,曾经将CW-20精度分别提高0.80.0.80和0.40.0.40个百分点,使AA精度不变,而FGSM和PGD-20精度下降1.201.20和1.401.40个百分点.
与最初的ARD基准相比,CARD一旦将纯度和FGSM的精度分别提高3.20 3.20和0.40 0.40个百分点,CW-20的精度保持不变,PGD-20和AA的精度分别降低1.00 1.00个百分点.
基于ARD的CARD变体在被评价的学生方法中实现了最高的清洁精度.

blocks.en:
Overall, the effect of CARD on TinyImageNet-10 varies with the base adversarial-distillation objective.
The AdaAD +IGDM-based variant improves both clean accuracy and robustness under all four evaluated attacks, whereas the AdaAD- and ARD-based variants exhibit metric-dependent trade-offs between clean and robust performance.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,CARD对TinyImageNet-10的影响随基本对抗-消化目标而不同.
基于AdaAD + IGDM的变体在所有4起被评价的攻击中都提高了清洁准确性和稳健性,而基于AdaAD和ARD的变体则在清洁和稳健性能之间表现出了依赖衡量的取舍。

blocks.en: 4.3 Black-Box Transfer Robustness
blocks.zh: 4.3 黑牛转移力

blocks.en: We further evaluate the transfer-based black-box robustness of CARD on CIFAR-100 using independently trained robust and naturally trained surrogate models.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估CIFAR-100上基于转移的黑箱坚固性,使用独立训练的强健和自然训练的代孕模型。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Results with Robust Surrogates.
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 与强健代孕者取得的结果。

blocks.en:
Table 5 reports the transfer-based black-box results with ResNet-18 as the target student and ResNet-18, VGG-19, and MobileNet-V2 as robust surrogate models.
Compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD twice improves transferred-attack accuracy by 0.52 0.52 – 1.02 1.02 percentage points across all six surrogate-attack combinations.
blocks.zh:
表5以ResNet-18为目标学生的基于传输的黑盒结果报告,而ResNet-18,VGG-19,和MobileNet-V2为强健的代理模型.
与原样相比 AdaAD基线,运用CARD两次将转移攻击精度提高0.52 0.52 – 1.02 1.02分,在所有6个代发攻击组合中.

blocks.en:
Compared with the original AdaAD+IGDM baseline, applying CARD once also improves transferred-attack accuracy across all six surrogate-attack combinations, with gains ranging from 0.17 0.17 to 0.47 0.47 percentage points.
These results indicate that CARD consistently improves transfer-based black-box robustness against attacks generated from multiple robust surrogate architectures.
blocks.zh:
与最初的AdaAD+IGDM基线相比,CARD一度也提高了所有六个代发攻击组合的转移攻击精度,收益从0.170.17到0.470.47个百分点.
这些结果表明,CARD持续地改进了基于转移的黑箱强力,以对抗由多根强力替代架构所引发的攻击.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Results with Natural Surrogates.
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 自然代孕的结果。

blocks.en:
Tables 6 and 7 report the transfer-based black-box results with ResNet-18 as the target student and ResNet-18, MobileNet-V2, VGG-19, ResNet-50, DenseNet-169, and WRN-34-10 as naturally trained surrogate models.
PGD-100 and CW-100 adversarial examples generated on each surrogate are directly transferred to the target student.
blocks.zh:
表6和表7报告以ResNet-18为目标学生的基于传输的黑盒结果以及以ResNet-18,MobileNet-V2,VGG-19,ResNet-50,DenseNet-169和WRN-34-10为自然训练的代孕模型.
在每个代孕者身上产生的PGD-100和CW-100对抗性实例被直接转移给目标学生.

blocks.en:
Compared with the original AdaAD baseline, applying CARD once improves transferred-attack accuracy by 0.59 0.59 – 0.82 0.82 percentage points across all 12 surrogate-attack combinations.
Applying CARD twice also improves all 12 combinations over the original AdaAD baseline, with gains ranging from 0.57 0.57 to 1.03 1.03 percentage points.
blocks.zh:
与原样相比 AdaAD基线,运用CARD一次将转移攻击精度提高了0.59 0.59 — 0.82 0.82分,在所有12个代发攻击组合中.
应用CARD两次也比最初的AdaAD基线改进了所有12个组合,收益从0.570.57到1.03 1.03个百分点.

blocks.en: Overall, these results demonstrate consistent improvements in transfer-based black-box robustness across attacks generated from multiple robust and naturally trained surrogate architectures.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,通过多种强健和自然训练的代孕结构产生的攻击,基于转移的黑箱坚固性不断得到改进。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation studies to examine three aspects of CARD:
(1) whether weak-to-strong teacher refinement contributes beyond additional student training,
(2) whether teacher refinement and student gain transfer should be optimized jointly or sequentially, and
(3) how different supervision signals affect teacher refinement.
Unless otherwise specified, the student is initialized from the checkpoint obtained after the initial strong-to-weak adversarial distillation stage, whereas the teacher is initialized from the pretrained robust teacher.
All teacher-refinement variants use an ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} perturbation budget of ϵ = 8 / 255 \epsilon=8/255 , with 10 inner optimization steps and a step size of 2 / 255 2/255 .
blocks.zh:
我们进行减征研究,以审查《保护自然资源公约》的三个方面:
(一) 薄弱到强壮的教师的完善是否有助于补充学生培训;
(2) 教师的完善和学生的增益转移应共同优化还是相继优化,
(3)不同的监督信号如何影响教师的完善.
除非另有说明,该学生在最初的强至弱对抗分层阶段后从检查站被初始化,而教师则从经过预先培训的强力教师中被初始化。

blocks.en: 4.4.1 Contribution of the Cyclic Components
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 循环部分的贡献

blocks.en:
We first examine whether the improvement of CARD can be attributed simply to additional student training.
The baseline corresponds to the original AdaAD student.
The S2W-only variant removes weak-to-strong (W2S) teacher refinement and directly continues strong-to-weak (S2W) student training under the guidance of the unchanged teacher using the original AdaAD objective.
The complete CARD variant performs W2S teacher refinement before the subsequent S2W gain-transfer stage.
blocks.zh:
我们首先审查是否可将改善CARD仅仅归因于额外的学生培训。
基线对应最初的AdaAD学生.
S2W唯能变体去除弱到强(W2S)的师资改良,并直接在不变的师资指导下用AdaAD最初的目标来继续强到弱(S2W)的学生训练.
完整的CARD变体在后来的S2W增益-转移阶段之前完成W2S师资的改进.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 8 , compared with the original AdaAD baseline, S2W-only training improves CW-20 and AA accuracy by 0.55 0.55 and 0.60 0.60 percentage points, respectively, but reduces clean accuracy by 0.86 0.86 percentage points.
Compared with S2W-only training, adding W2S teacher refinement further improves clean, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 1.15 1.15 , 0.56 0.56 , and 0.25 0.25 percentage points, respectively.
Consequently, the complete CARD framework outperforms the original AdaAD baseline by 0.29 0.29 percentage points in clean accuracy and by 1.11 1.11 and 0.85 0.85 percentage points under CW-20 and AA, respectively.
These results indicate that the improvement of CARD cannot be explained solely by additional student training and that W2S teacher refinement provides an additional contribution.

相较于S2W-只进行训练,增加W2S师资精度后会进一步提高清,CW-20,AA的精度,分别为1.15分,0.56分和0.25分.
因此,在CW-20和AA之下,完整的CARD框架的绩效分别比原AdaAD基线的清洁准确度高出0.29 0.29个百分点和1.11 1.11和0.85 0.85个百分点。
这些结果表明,改善CARD不能仅仅通过增加学生培训来解释,W2S教师的完善提供了额外的贡献.

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Separated versus Joint Optimization
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 分离与联合优化

blocks.en:
We next examine whether W2S teacher refinement and S2W student gain transfer should be optimized jointly or sequentially.
CARD adopts separated optimization, in which teacher refinement is completed before the refined teacher guides the subsequent student gain-transfer stage.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来要检查W2S教师的完善和S2W学生增益转移是应该联合优化还是顺序优化.
CARD采用分离优化,其中在被完善的教师指导随后的学生增益转移阶段之前完成教师的完善.

blocks.en:

As shown in Table 9 , compared with joint optimization, separated optimization improves clean accuracy by 1.31 1.31 percentage points and improves PGD-20, CW-20, and AA accuracy by 0.07 0.07 , 0.11 0.11 , and 0.10 0.10 percentage points, respectively.

blocks.en: 4.4.3 Teacher-Refinement Signals
blocks.zh: 4.4.3 教师改造信号

blocks.en:
We further investigate how different supervision signals affect teacher refinement.
During refinement, the student is frozen and only the teacher is updated.
After each refinement variant, the resulting teacher is frozen and the same student undergoes the subsequent S2W gain-transfer stage using the AdaAD objective.
Therefore, the variants differ only in the supervision used for teacher refinement.
The w/o Refinement variant directly performs additional student training using the unchanged teacher. GT Only removes model-prediction supervision and relies only on ground-truth labels. Teacher Clean + GT uses the teacher’s clean prediction for robust refinement and the ground-truth label for clean-input refinement, thereby removing student feedback. Student Clean uses the clean student prediction for both refinement branches and therefore removes inverse adversarial feedback. Student Inverse instead uses the inverse-adversarial student prediction for both branches. Teacher Inverse replaces student feedback with the corresponding inverse-adversarial teacher prediction.
The complete CARD objective combines the clean student prediction for robust refinement with the inverse-adversarial student prediction for natural refinement.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查不同监督信号如何影响教师的完善。
在完善期间,学生被冻结,只有教师更新.
在每一个改进变体后,产生的老师被冻结,同一个学生利用AdaAD目标接受之后的S2W增益转移阶段.
因此,这些变体仅在用于教师改进的监督方面有所不同。
改进变体直接使用不变的教师进行额外的学生培训。 一般事务人员 只取消了模型预测监督,只依靠地上真实的标签. 教师清洁+GT使用老师的清洁预测来进行强力的完善和地面真实标签来进行清洁输入的完善,从而去除学生的反馈. 学生Clean将学生的清洁预测用于两个完善分支,从而去除反向对抗反馈. 学生反相取而代之的是两个分支都采用反相取舍的学生预测. 教师反向用相应的反相对抗的教师预测取代学生反馈.
完整的CARD目标结合了学生的清洁预测来进行强健的完善和学生的逆向预测来进行自然的完善.

blocks.en:
For the prediction-based variants, the perturbed teacher input is constructed by maximizing the discrepancy between the corresponding reference prediction and the teacher prediction on the perturbed input.
For GT Only , the perturbed input is instead generated by maximizing the teacher’s cross-entropy loss.
The inverse variants construct the corresponding inverse adversarial input by minimizing the ground-truth cross-entropy loss of the student or teacher within the same perturbation set.
These definitions isolate the effects of student feedback, inverse adversarial feedback, and the choice of supervision signal while keeping the subsequent student gain-transfer stage unchanged.

All other training and refinement settings are kept unchanged.
We vary λ \lambda separately in the first- and second-cycle refinement stages and evaluate both the refined teacher and the student obtained after the subsequent gain-transfer stage.

blocks.en: 4.6 Qualitative and Mechanistic Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 定性和机械分析

blocks.en:
We provide complementary qualitative analyses to examine the attention patterns learned by CARD and the prediction behavior underlying weak-to-strong teacher refinement.
Specifically, Grad-CAM visualizations are used to compare discriminative attention under adversarial perturbations, while confusion matrices are used to examine the class consistency of inverse-adversarial feedback and the prediction changes induced by teacher refinement and subsequent gain transfer.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了补充性的质量分析,以审查CARD所学到的注意模式以及教师中弱到强的改进背后的预测行为。
具体地说,Grad-CAM可视化用于比较对抗性扰动下的歧视性关注,而混淆矩阵则用于审查逆向对抗反馈的阶级一致性和由师资完善和随后收益转移所引发的预测变化.

blocks.en: 4.6.1 Grad-CAM Visualizations
blocks.zh: 4.6.1 梯级CAM 可视化

blocks.en:
We use Grad-CAM [ 32 ] to visualize the discriminative regions emphasized by different models on adversarial CIFAR-100 inputs.
As shown in Fig. 4 , several baseline students exhibit relatively fragmented activation patterns or place substantial attention on background regions.
In contrast, the CARD student shows more spatially concentrated activation on object-relevant regions in the visualized examples and exhibits greater qualitative similarity to the robust teacher.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Grad-CAM[32]来直观地描绘不同模式在对抗性CIFAR-100投入上强调的歧视性区域.
如图4所示,一些基线学生表现出相对分散的激活模式,或对背景区域给予很大关注。
相比之下,CARD学生在可视化的例子中,在空间上更加集中在与物体有关的地区,并表现出与强健的教师在质量上更加相似。

blocks.en:
Compared with the baselines, the CARD student attends more consistently to object-relevant regions and shows activation patterns closer to those of the robust teacher under adversarial perturbations.
This qualitative similarity suggests that the student better retains the discriminative patterns of the robust teacher, consistent with the improved robustness observed in the quantitative results.
blocks.zh:
与基线相比,CARD学生更一贯地参加与物体有关的地区,并显示出在对抗性扰动下与强健教师更接近的激活模式.
这种质的相似性表明,学生更好地保留了强健教师的歧视性模式,这与量化结果中观察到的强健性的提高是一致的.

blocks.en: To examine the feasibility of weak-to-strong teacher refinement, we analyze whether inverse adversarial student predictions provide sufficiently reliable feedback to the teacher.

All models achieve over 96 % 96\% accuracy on inverse adversarial inputs, with predictions strongly concentrated along the main diagonal. This indicates that inverse adversarial inputs preserve reliable class-consistent information for teacher refinement.

The refined teacher and final student show slight decreases on inverse adversarial inputs while remaining above 96 % 96\% .
Because these perturbations are optimized to facilitate correct classification, the reduced benefit from them, together with improved adversarial accuracy, suggests less sensitivity to input perturbations.
Overall, consistent with Theorems 1 and 2 , the results provide empirical support that reliable student feedback can be transferred to the teacher when it has a positive prediction margin and is sufficiently aligned with the teacher output.

精细的师生和最后学生显示,反向对抗性投入略有减少,但仍保持在96%以上。
由于这些扰动被优化以方便正确的分类,因此从中得益的减少,加上对抗性精度的提高,表明对输入扰动的敏感度较低.
总体来说,与定理1和2一致,结果提供了经验支持,即当学生的可靠反馈具有正向预测比值并充分与教师产出相匹配时,该反馈可以转移给教师.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we proposed Cyclic Adversarial Robust Distillation (CARD), which extends conventional one-way adversarial robustness distillation into a closed teacher–student feedback loop consisting of strong-to-weak distillation, weak-to-strong teacher refinement, and subsequent gain transfer.
CARD uses inverse-adversarial student feedback and discrepancy-maximizing inputs to refine the teacher while retaining the base student-distillation objective.
We further provided theoretical conditions for reliable weak-to-strong feedback and showed experimentally that CARD improves adversarial robustness in most evaluated settings under both white-box and transfer-based black-box attacks.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了Cyclic Adversarial Robust Distillation(CARD),将常规的单向对抗强力分馏扩展为封闭式教师-学生反馈循环,包括强力到弱力分馏,弱力到强力的教师完善,以及随后的收益转移。
CARD使用反向对抗的学生反馈和差异最大化的投入来完善教师,同时保留学生分散的基本目标.
我们进一步为可靠的弱到强反馈提供了理论条件,并实验性地表明,CARD在被评价的大多数环境下,在白箱和以转移为基础的黑箱攻击下,提高了对抗力.

blocks.en:
CARD still has several limitations.
Its current evaluation is restricted to relatively small-scale image classification benchmarks and primarily considers ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} -bounded attacks, while the additional refinement and gain-transfer stages introduce extra training cost.
Moreover, the improvement is not uniform across all attacks and base distillation methods.
Future work will investigate more efficient refinement strategies, larger-scale models and datasets, broader threat models, and adaptive feedback mechanisms that can better determine when and how student knowledge should be used to refine the teacher.
blocks.zh:
CARD仍有若干限制。
其目前的评价仅限于规模相对较小的图像分类基准,并主要考虑被限制的攻击,而额外的改进和收益转移阶段则引入额外的培训费用。
此外,所有攻击和基地蒸馏方法的改进并不一致。
今后的工作将调查更有效的完善战略、规模更大的模型和数据集、更广泛的威胁模型以及适应性的反馈机制,这些可以更好地确定何时以及如何利用学生的知识来完善教师。
